row.evidence: Zight's pricing page lists 'SSO/SCIM & group-based permissions' under the Scale plan (Talk to sales), and the Okta SCIM guide says the feature is available only on the Scale plans.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated on Scale). Plans renamed again since June: Share (free), Create $9.95/u/mo (individual, solo creators), Collaborate $12/u/mo (teams of 2+), Scale (Talk to sales). June's team plan 'Pro $9.95' is now Create, which the pricing page marks as an individual plan, so the team plan is Collaborate $12 (annual; $15 monthly implied by 'Save $72.00 a year' for 2 users). SAML SSO is Scale only (lower tiers get Google sign-in only). SCIM base URL and bearer token are issued by Zight Support; Okta (with Push Groups) and OneLogin setups are documented; pricing claims Azure and Google SCIM too. The Okta OIN entry is the legacy CloudApp SWA app. docs_url is the Zendesk JSON export of https://support.zight.com/hc/en-us/articles/5825280798743-Enable-Okta-SCIM-Provisioning-for-Zight

plans.name: Share
plans.notes: Share, Create and Collaborate show SAML SSO as "(Google Only)", i.e. Google sign-in, which does not count as SSO here.

plans.name: Create
plans.price_text: $9.95 per user / month, billed annually (for individuals)

auth.token_source: Issued by Zight Support or the Customer Success Manager (not self-serve)

operations.notes: Okta setup enables create users, update user attributes and deactivate users; PUT vs PATCH is not documented.

deprovision.notes: The Okta guide says removing users from the app disables them. For manual disables Zight says untransferred content is deleted and cannot be recovered; whether a SCIM disable triggers the same is not stated.

attributes.notes: Only Okta (unique identifier = email) and the OneLogin JSON template (email, details.first_name, details.last_name under urn:scim:schemas:core:1.0) are documented; group attribute names are not documented beyond Okta Push Groups.

roles.how: Group membership via Okta Push Groups (group-based permissions); no role attribute documented.

limitations.text: SCIM token must be requested from Zight Support/CSM; setup needs a custom SAML app and SSO configured first.
Group sync is one-way from Okta; Okta groups cannot be edited in Zight, and group sync does not import users.
Only Okta and OneLogin SCIM setups are documented; the Entra and Google guides cover SAML only.

user_api.notes: No public user-management or admin REST API found: help-centre search for "api" returns only integrations and the Record SDK; developer.zight.com does not resolve and zight.com/api and /developers return 404. User lists can be exported as CSV from the Members tab.

okta.notes: The OIN entry is the legacy "CloudApp" app (Zight's former name), marked SWA only and last updated Jul 2021. Zight's own guide provisions through a custom SAML app with SCIM enabled.

entra.notes: Zight documents a non-gallery SAML app; the pricing page says SCIM works with Azure but no Entra SCIM guide was found.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin; pricing claims Google SCIM but no setup guide exists.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic SCIM Provisioner with SAML (Core Schema v1.1) app.

jumpcloud.notes: Custom SAML app; no SCIM steps in the guide.

fallbacks.other_sync: Auto-join and domain lockdown let users with a company email join the workspace.
fallbacks.notes: CSV is export-only (member list with role and disabled_at), not import. Auto-join is required before enabling Okta SCIM.
